name: Tickets and check-in
description: Tickets, check-in and check-out, offline scan uploads and guest lists. Check-ins run the dashboard's door functions as the member who created the key (owner, manager or scanner), with the same rules: doors-open time, check-in lists, re-entry, rotating codes. A check-in that the door would refuse is not an error: the answer is 200 with ok false and the reason (doors-not-open, already-used, needs-manager, reason-required, voided, wrong-event, …).

endpoints.description: The organization's tickets across events, newest first. Never the barcode secret.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: Only this event's tickets.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only tickets in this status (active, used, voided, …).

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: Only this order's tickets.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-10000 (default 1). A page past the end answers an empty data array.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1-200 (default 50).

endpoints.description: Finds the ticket behind a ticket id or a rotating door code (T-<ticket>:…). It only finds the ticket; checking in with the code (POST /v1/tickets/:id/check-in with barcode) is what verifies it.

parameters.description: A ticket id or a T- door code (URL-encoded).

responses.description: OK.
The key lacks tickets:read.

endpoints.description: Checks a ticket in at its event. With barcode the code is verified like a camera scan; without one it is a typed override that needs an owner or manager and a reason. The scan is logged under the key's creator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ticket's id. One of another organization answers 404.

parameters.name: barcode
parameters.description: The door code a scanner read (T-… rotating code or W-… wallet code). Checked like a camera scan at the door; without one the check-in is a typed override.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Why, for a typed check-in (at least 3 characters; kept on the check-in).

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.description: The check-in list (gate) to check in on; its ticket types, hours and re-entry rules apply.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: A label for the scanner or app (shown in the check-in log). Default "api".

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. 8-100 letters, digits, _ . : or -. Resending a write with the same key replays the first answer (with "idempotent_replay": true) instead of doing it again; the same key on another action or target answers 400.

responses.description: The door's answer: ok, or ok false with the reason.

The key lacks checkin:write, or the member who created the key can't do this in the dashboard (owner, manager or scanner; a typed check-in without a door code needs an owner or manager and a reason), or has left the organization.
No such ticket in the key's organization (or the id is malformed).

endpoints.description: Scans a door app made while offline, up to 500 at a time, applied through the dashboard's offline sync: each client_ref is applied once (resending is safe), scanned_at must be within the event's scan window, and a ticket another device already admitted comes back as such. A ticket of another organization answers not-found for that scan. Opendate calls these offline check-in activities.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The event's id. One of another organization answers 404.

parameters.name: scans
parameters.description: Up to 500 { client_ref (UUID, unique per scan), ticket_id, scanned_at, barcode?, source? (camera, manual), reason?, device?, list_id?, direction? }.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. 8-100 letters, digits, _ . : or -. Resending a write with the same key replays the first answer (with "idempotent_replay": true) instead of doing it again; the same key on another action or target answers 400.

responses.description: One answer per scan, in order (ok false with bad-scan for a malformed one).
A bad field or value; the message names it.

responses.description: The key lacks checkin:write, or the member who created the key can't do this in the dashboard (owner, manager or scanner), or has left the organization.
